Mining wallet login and periodic balance synchronization still used the legacy node balance route and its independent shared upstream.
changes: Local preparation has its own action before task availability checks, after required RPC and wallet identity setup.
The V4 mining balance reader uses finalized SOL and FBW account reads through the required personal provider.
A successful login survives subsequent non-authentication balance synchronization failures.
Historical deposits, grants and records remain accessible through the original account page.
